title: Meet the 16 Mizaj types (one line each)
caption:
Sixteen types. One of them is you, and you'll know it instantly.

Meet the 16 Mizaj types in four families: Danishwar (the thinkers), Ahl-e-Dil (the heart-led), Pasban (the guardians) and Fankar (the makers). Every type has its own name, its own strengths and its own very specific way of surviving a family dinner.

Save this, swipe till you find yourself, then tag the cousin who is obviously the Mezbaan.

Which slide made you say 'bas, yeh main hoon'?
